description.zh: 启用或禁用窗口。无需修改为空。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable or disable the O&M window. Leave this parameter empty if no modification is needed.

description.zh: 需要修改的运维窗口的Id。必传参数。
description.en: The ID of the O&M window to modify. This parameter is required.

description.zh: 运维创建名称，无需修为空。
description.en: The name of the O&M window. Leave this parameter empty if no modification is needed.

description.zh: 实例所在的地域ID。您可以调用DescribeRegions查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the instance. You can call DescribeRegions to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: 支持的运维动作。无需修改为空。
description.en: The supported O&M actions. Leave this parameter empty if no modification is needed.

description.zh: 运维窗口生效的资源，无需修改为空
description.en: The resource to which the O&M window applies. Leave this parameter empty if no modification is needed.

description.zh: 窗口循环周期。无需修改为空。
description.en: The recurring cycle of the O&M window. Leave this parameter empty if no modification is needed.

descriptions.zh: 修改运维窗口的属性。当运维窗口TargetResource参数设置关联的ECS实例，底层发生硬件隐患，需要通过计划运维来规避的时候，计划运维的执行时间会根据运维窗口TimePeriod 参数设置的区间来设置。当到达运维事件的执行时间后，平台会自动根据运维事件的类型来执行响应的运维操作
descriptions.en: Modifies the attributes of an O&M window. When the TargetResource parameter of an O&M window is set to associate ECS instances and underlying hardware risks are detected that require scheduled O&M to mitigate, the execution time of the scheduled O&M is determined based on the time range specified by the TimePeriod parameter of the O&M window. When the execution time of an O&M event is reached, the platform automatically performs the corresponding O&M operation based on the type of the O&M event.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs modify-plan-maintenance-window --plan-window-id pw-bp1au1w8v8a1yer65g5k --plan-window-name WIndowName --enable false --support-maintenance-action Reboot --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --time-period '{"RangeList":[{"EndTime":"Tuesday,03:00","StartTime":"Monday,22:00"}],"PeriodUnit":"Year"}' --target-resource '{"Scope":"Tag","ResourceGroupId":"rg-acfmy4cc27vsvia","Tags":[{"Value":"tagValue","Key":"tagKey"}]}' --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs ModifyPlanMaintenanceWindow --region cn-hangzhou --SupportMaintenanceAction Reboot --TargetResource '{"Scope":"Tag","ResourceGroupId":"rg-acfmy4cc27vsvia","Tags":[{"Value":"tagValue","Key":"tagKey"}]}' --TimePeriod '{"RangeList":[{"EndTime":"Tuesday,03:00","StartTime":"Monday,22:00"}],"PeriodUnit":"Year"}' --PlanWindowName WIndowName --Enable false --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --PlanWindowId 'pw-bp1au1w8v8a1yer65g5k'
